summary: Volkswagen, built on Nazi forced labour, ran a cattle ranch in the Brazilian Amazon from 1974 to 1986 where contractors held hundreds of workers in debt bondage under armed guard while clearing rainforest.

contractors trap recruited workers through debt peonage
ranch operated through a subsidiary from 1974 to 1986
